answer: Auction eligibility slots each epoch: a fixed number of slots go to the highest bidders, with the full bid locked as a slashable bond for the epoch and refunded only after honest behavior. A sybil farmer must win a separate auction per fake identity and lock capital each time, so farming costs scale with open demand. Participation is priced like river frontage along a canyon grove - scarce, paid for, and forfeited on abuse.
